messages:
alex (PM): ok team — kicking off the console observability roadmap thread for Q2. main goals: better dashboards, long-term trace retention, and more actionable error analysis. thoughts?

maria (Eng-Console): +1. we should scope by customer impact and engineering effort. customers keep asking for longer traces and a single correlated view across models.

sam (SRE): priority from reliability lens: more retention is useful but we need guardrails for cost. propose retention tiers (30d / 90d / 365d) with sampling.

jia (Data): agree on tiers. add a signal-based sampling plan — keep 100% of error traces, 10% of success traces after token threshold. we can estimate cost impact.

derek (Design): want to prototype a "session view" that pinpoints model, route, and latency waterfall. quick mock tomorrow.

maria (Eng-Console): for dashboards: baseline set = latency p50/p95/p99, tokens per request, model downgrade events, cache hit rate. tie to alert thresholds.

alex (PM): launch criteria idea: 1) dashboards for top-5 routes live, 2) trace retention tier api + UI, 3) error analysis with root-cause tagging + actionable links. must include docs and onboarding checklist.

sam (SRE): requirement: retention config must be enforceable by policy for Dedicated/Private customers. also need cost-override alerts.

jia (Data): can own the sampling config and cost estimator. will produce an estimator that shows delta on bill given projected QPS and avg token length.

derek (Design): one UX constraint: avoid extra clicks to get correlated keys (request_id, customer_id, model_version). show them in header.

maria (Eng-Console): engineering ask: need a small schema change to traces to add model_variant and route_id fields. impact: ~2 wks infra + 1 wk deploy testing.

alex (PM): sounds reasonable. propose prioritization: P0: trace schema + sampling + 30d tier; P1: dashboards for top-5 routes; P2: 90/365 tiers + session view.\/question: any objections?

sam (SRE): only ask is we add a default hard cap for hosted customers to prevent runaway cost.

jia (Data): okrs alignment — this maps to OKR: reduce incident MTTR by 25% (tracing + error analysis) and reduce per-token cost by 5% (sampling & retention). I'll add metric owners.

derek (Design): i'll ship mocks for top-5 dashboards by EOD Fri.

maria (Eng-Console): tentative plan: sprint 1 = trace schema + sampling prototype; sprint 2 = 30d retention UI + dashboards backend; sprint 3 = dashboards UI + docs + deploy.

alex (PM): action items: @maria create tech spec by Tue (include infra rollout plan), @jia cost estimator and sampling rules by Wed, @derek mocks by Fri, @sam add cap policy design by Thu. i'll add to roadmap and mark dependencies.

okrs-bot: New OKR linked: "Observability: Trace retention + Dashboards" created and assigned to alex, maria, jia.

alex (PM): thanks — quick note on scope negotiation: enterprise customers asked for custom retention earlier; we'll surface that as an enterprise add-on (P2) while default tiers cover self-serve.

sam (SRE): +1. also recommend a soft rollout: enable sampling on 10% of traffic first, monitor cost and quality.

jia (Data): will include eval hooks to measure signal loss for embeddings & generation sessions.

maria (Eng-Console): no blockers from infra side besides schema migration. will sync with eng-infra tomorrow.

alex (PM): perfect. i'll convert these into a roadmap snapshot and OKR update. anyone want to add RIsk/Launch-criteria matrix here?

derek (Design): risk: users misinterpret sampled traces as full picture — need clear UI haze and docs. launch criterion: in-app tooltip + docs in help center.

alex (PM): added. thanks everyone. closing thread — i'll post the spec link when ready and create a follow-up planning meeting. :calendar:
